abstract: Evaluates subterranean imaging methods, acoustic array geometry, and sensor spacing
system_message:
You are the Geophysical forensics director (GEOPHYS). Your business responsibilities are to evaluate subterranean imaging methods, acoustic array geometry, and sensor spacing, as well as review lithological borehole logging across proposed forensic investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates subterranean imaging methods, acoustic array geometry, and sensor spacing（SUBSURF）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-SUBSURF-UGI：Cross-borehole radar and hydrophone tomography in the reporting period July 2025: Deep electrical resistivity tomography capability is true; Acoustic listening protocol validation is false; Acoustic sensor deployment spacing is 15 m.
GEOPHYS-SUBSURF-PGX：Microgravimetric mapping and isotopic tracer injection in the reporting period June 2025: Deep electrical resistivity tomography capability is true; Acoustic listening protocol validation is true; Acoustic sensor deployment spacing is 10 m.
GEOPHYS-SUBSURF-YXU：Distributed acoustic sensing and dye-dilution profiling in the reporting period June 2025: Deep electrical resistivity tomography capability is true; Acoustic listening protocol validation is true; Acoustic sensor deployment spacing is 25 m.
GEOPHYS-SUBSURF-99U：Cross-borehole radar and hydrophone tomography in the reporting period June 2025: Deep electrical resistivity tomography capability is true; Acoustic listening protocol validation is true; Acoustic sensor deployment spacing is 15 m.

information_points.title: Lithological borehole logging（BORELOG）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-BORELOG-3AO：For Distributed acoustic sensing and dye-dilution profiling, geotechnical exploratory boreholes drilled in the aqueduct easement during 2026 demonstrated a borehole core recovery ratio of 92%.
GEOPHYS-BORELOG-KVT：For Microgravimetric mapping and isotopic tracer injection, geotechnical exploratory boreholes drilled in the aqueduct easement during 2026 demonstrated a borehole core recovery ratio of 98%.
GEOPHYS-BORELOG-FB7：For Cross-borehole radar and hydrophone tomography, geotechnical exploratory boreholes drilled in the aqueduct easement during 2026 demonstrated a borehole core recovery ratio of 85%.
